headline: RapWire 24/7: GTA VI, Eminem, GloRilla, Cam’ron and Snoop Dogg
caption:
1) Grand Theft Auto VI opened with $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales, according to Rockstar, after 32.5 million units moved before launch. The record-setting debut puts Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval at the center of the biggest console event in the series’ history. @RockstarGames
2) Eminem’s co-publishers Eight Mile Style and Martin Affiliated filed an amended complaint adding 108 alleged Suno outputs tied to 26 Eminem songs. The filing is a new evidentiary step in the copyright case, and the claims remain allegations for the court to test. @Eminem
3) GloRilla says she is sitting on “so many hits” and told fans to stop playing and drop the music. She has not announced a release date, but the post points toward the Memphis rapper’s sophomore album following her 2024 debut Glorious. @GloTheofficial
4) Cam’ron released “Optimistic” with an official video as the first taste of Cam’ron Presents: Frederica, now planned for early 2027. The project is named for his late mother and is being developed with a companion film, giving the rollout a personal, cross-medium shape.
5) Snoop Dogg shared that the final day of his biopic shoot had arrived, signaling that principal photography has wrapped on the Universal project. Jonathan Daviss plays Snoop, Craig Brewer directs, and the film is currently set for an August 6, 2027 theatrical release. @SnoopDogg
body: RapWire’s Nov. 22 morning carousel tracks Grand Theft Auto VI’s record first-day sales, the amended Eminem-publisher lawsuit against Suno, GloRilla’s sophomore-album tease, Cam’ron’s new Frederica rollout, and Snoop Dogg’s biopic wrap. Each slide pairs current verified reporting with original late-1980s editorial-comic art, readable headline/deck layers, a visible actual subject, and the official transparent RapWire mark.

Each slide pairs current verified reporting with original late-1980s editorial-comic art, readable headline/deck layers, a visible actual subject, and the official transparent RapWire mark.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: GTA VI SETS A $3.79B OPEN
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI made $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales after 32.5 million pre-launch units. The record-setting debut makes the long-awaited Vice City crime saga a massive console event.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: EMINEM SUIT EXPANDS
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Eight Mile Style and Martin Affiliated added 108 alleged Suno outputs tied to 26 Eminem songs in an amended federal complaint. The filing keeps the publisher’s claims alive while the court weighs the broader copyright fight.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: GLORILLA SITTING ON HITS
slide_editorial_copy.deck: GloRilla says she is sitting on “so many hits” and teased an elevated, summer-minded sophomore album without announcing a date. The post gives her two-year-old debut era its clearest next-chapter signal yet.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: CAM'RON GETS OPTIMISTIC
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Cam’ron released “Optimistic,” the first single and video from Cam’ron Presents: Frederica, now slated for early 2027. The project honors his late mother and is planned with a companion film.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: SNOOP WRAPS BIOPIC
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Snoop Dogg posted that the last day of his Universal biopic shoot had arrived, closing principal photography on the film starring Jonathan Daviss. Craig Brewer directs, with the movie set for theaters in August 2027.
